verdict.rationale: Azure documents managed identities that let applications obtain Microsoft Entra tokens without managing any credentials. That is a first-party, credential-free path for services running on Azure. Nothing in the pack shows OIDC or workload identity federation for external CI systems, short-lived token issuance to pipelines, or an end-to-end setup guide. missing for 10: OIDC/workload identity federation for CI (e.g., trust configuration with external identity providers), explicit short-lived credential lifetimes, end-to-end documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
